output_units: nonnegative expected count per20ms bin; NOT Hz
feature_description: 35 successive20ms time bins of107held-in neurons, movement-onset aligned from-250to+450ms. Predict corresponding35held-out neurons. Temporal smoothing may use whole same-trial context; no smoothing across trials. Return nonnegative finite expected counts shape(N,35,35).
grouping: Official held-out test trials, same macaque Jenkins/small session. Official train+val combined; final trial199 excluded by official reader because no valid aligned timepoints.99training/100test trials. No cross-animal or cross-session generalization claim.
baseline_name: Gaussian sigma1bin population readout + Ridge alpha100, positive clipping1e-6
terms: CC BY4.0 DANDI dataset; MIT nlb_tools vendored with license. Official test truth released publicly January2026.
evaluation_regime: T3 code synthesis plus external supervised population readout fitting
metric_details: Official NLB bits/spike=(PoissonNLL of per-neuron evaluation-set mean minus modelNLL)/(totalspikes*ln2). Evaluation-set mean only normalizes score, never supplied to model or used for fitting. Zero rates set1e-9 exactly as official scorer; negative rates fail. Additional train-mean-null score may be separately named.
